ingredients.title: Filling
items: 2 tsp grated lemon peel, if desired

instructions.title: Crust
items: Mix together until crumbly and press in an ungreased 8x8 or 9x9 square pan, building up 1/2 inch around the edges.

instructions.title: Filling
items: Beat granulated sugar, lemon peel, lemon juice, baking powder, salt, flour and eggs with electric mixer on high speed about 3 minutes or until light and fluffy.
Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until no indentation remains when touched lightly in center.
Cool; dust with powdered sugar. Cut into about 1 1/2-inch squares.
